title: RNA-binding protein RBM34 promotes hepatic fibrosis by enhancing DROSHA-mediated nuclear export of Loxl2 mRNA.
abstract: Hepatic fibrosis is driven by excessive extracellular matrix (ECM) deposition from activated hepatic stellate cells (HSCs). Although RNA-binding proteins (RBPs) are emerging as key regulators of HSC activation, the role of RBM34 in liver fibrosis remains unexplored. Here we show that RBM34 is markedly upregulated in human and murine fibrotic livers, predominantly in activated HSCs, and is potently induced by TGFβ. RBM34 enhances fibrotic marker expression and HSC contractility, and HSC-specific knockdown attenuates liver fibrosis in vivo. Mechanistically, STAMP (survey targets by APOBEC-mediated profiling) and RNA immunoprecipitation (RIP) analyses identified lysyl oxidase-like 2 (Loxl2) mRNA as a direct RBM34 target. RBM34 interacts with DROSHA to promote nuclear export and translation of Loxl2 mRNA independently of DROSHA's canonical RNase III activity. Collectively, these findings uncover a non-canonical role for DROSHA in mRNA trafficking and establish the RBM34-DROSHA-LOXL2 axis as a driver of hepatic fibrogenesis, highlighting RBM34 as a potential therapeutic target.

summary.title_zh: RNA结合蛋白RBM34通过增强DROSHA介导的Loxl2 mRNA核输出促进肝纤维化
summary.enzyme_type: Drosha（Class II RNase III家族成员，典型功能为核内pri-miRNA加工；本文揭示其不依赖经典RNase III催化活性的非经典mRNA转运功能）
summary.mechanism: RBM34作为RNA结合蛋白直接结合Loxl2 mRNA，并与DROSHA相互作用，促进Loxl2 mRNA的核输出和翻译；该过程不依赖DROSHA的经典RNase III切割活性，体现DROSHA在mRNA转运中的非经典调控角色。RBM34在活化肝星状细胞中经TGFβ诱导上调，通过RBM34-DROSHA-LOXL2轴增强纤维化标志物表达和HSC收缩性，驱动肝纤维化。
summary.engineering: 本文未涉及蛋白工程化改造或可编程RNA切割设计；应用价值在于将RBM34识别为肝纤维化潜在治疗靶点，HSC特异性敲低RBM34在体内减轻肝纤维化，提示靶向RBM34-DROSHA-LOXL2轴可能具有抗纤维化治疗潜力。
summary.key_results: RBM34在人及小鼠纤维化肝脏中显著上调，主要见于活化HSC，并由TGFβ强烈诱导；STAMP和RIP分析鉴定Loxl2 mRNA为RBM34直接靶标；RBM34与DROSHA互作促进Loxl2 mRNA核输出和翻译，且不依赖DROSHA的RNase III活性；HSC特异性敲低RBM34在体内减轻肝纤维化。
